{#- The "On this page" panel, overriding the Shibuya template of the same name so the heading can collapse the panel. The heading is a button rather than plain text, so the whole row is the control: clicking it hides the list and hands the width back to the page. Below 1280px the panel is a drawer with its own close button, so the stylesheet makes this one inert there. State lives on and is set by _static/sidebar-toggle.js. Which of the two icons shows is decided in CSS, so no script has to swap them. aria-controls names the panel, not the #rside aside: Shibuya rewrites aria-expanded on every element that claims aria-controls="rside" when its drawer opens, which would fight this button. -#} {%- if display_toc -%}

{{ toc }}
{%- endif -%}
